senses.gloss: सं-ह (prob. = सं-घ) in comp.
सं-ह—तल m. the two hands joined with the open palms brought together, L. (cf. संहत- and संघ-त्)
सं-ह—तापन m. N. of a serpent-demon, MBh.
सं-ह॑त् f. (prob.) a layer, pile, RV. iii, 1, 7.
सं-हत mfn. struck together, closely joined or united with (instr.), keeping together, contiguous, coherent, combined, compacted, forming one mass or body, ĀśvŚr.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
accompanied or attended by (instr.), Mn. vii, 165
become solid, compact, firm, hard, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
strong-limbed, athletic, MBh.
strong, intensive, VarBṛS.
(prob.) complex, composite, compound (said of a partic. tone and odour), MBh.
struck, hurt, wounded, killed, W.
सं-हत n. a partic. position in dancing, Saṃgīt.
सं-हात m. (for सं-घात, which is often v.l.) conciseness (in, अक्षर-स्˚), Sāh.
N. of a partic. hell, Mn. iv, 89
of one of Śiva's attendants, L.
सं-हत—कुलीन mfn. belonging to a family closely allied or related, ĀpŚr., Sch.
सं-हत—जानु mfn. knock-kneed, L.
सं-हत—जानुक mfn. knock-kneed, L.
सं-हत—तल m. the two hands joined with the open palms brought together, W.
सं-हत—ता f. close contact or union, Śiś.
सं-हत—त्व n. id., Pañcat. (v.l.)
complexity, compactness, close combination, W.
सं-हत—पुच्छि ind. with contracted tail g. द्विदण्ड्य्-आदि
सं-हत—भ्रू mfn. knitting the brows, MBh.
सं-हत—भ्रूकुटि-मुख mfn. one on whose face the brows are contracted, ib.
सं-हत—मूर्ति mfn. of compact form or shape, strong, intensive, VarBṛS.
सं-हत—वाक्-कल mfn. (du.) ‘joining the tones of the voice’, singing a duet, MārkP.
सं-हत—वृत्तोरु mfn. one who has round and firm thighs, R.
सं-हत—स्तनी f. a woman whose breasts are very close to each other, MW.
सं-हत—हस्त mfn. seizing or holding each other by the hand (-त्व, n.), Gobh., Sch.
सं-हत—हस्त—त्व n.
सं-ह˚ताङ्ग mfn. strong-limbed, well-knit, Suśr.
in close contiguity (as hills), MBh.
सं-ह˚ताञ्जलि mfn. joining the hollowed hands (as a mark of supplication), Hariv.
सं-ह˚ताश्व m. N. of a king (son of Nikumbha), Hariv.
सं-ह˚तोरु mfn. firm-thighed, MBh.
संहति f. striking together, closure, Kāv.; ŚārṅgS.
compactness, solidity, MBh.; VarBṛS.
thickening, swelling, ŚārṅgS.
keeping together, saving, economy, Kāv.
firm union or alliance, junction, joint effort, close contact or connection with (instr.), Kāv.; Pur.; Rājat.
a seam, Kum.
a compact mass, bulk, heap, collection, multitude, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
संहति—शलिन् mfn. thick, dense, Śiś.
सं˚हती-भाव m. close union or connection, Car.,
सं˚हत्य ind. having struck or put together &c.
joined, combined together with (instr.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सं-हात्य n. (v.l. सं-घात्य) violation of an alliance (by means of persuasion or bribery, or by the operation of fate), Sāh.
सांहत्य n. (fr. सं-हत; see सं√ हन्) connection, union, Kap.
सं˚हत्य—कारिन् mfn. working together or with joined effort, BhP.
सं˚हत्य—कारि-ता f. common work or endeavour, KātyŚr.
सं˚हत्य—कारि-त्व n. common work or endeavour, KātyŚr.
सं-हनन mfn. compact, solid, firm, MBh.; BhP.
making compact or solid, Suśr.
striking together, MW.
killing, destroying, a destroyer, ib.
सं-हनन m. N. of a son of Manasyu, MBh.
सं-हनन n. the act of striking together, Suśr.
hardening, ib.
solidity, compactness, robustness, strength, muscularity, MBh.; R. &c.
firmness, steadfastness, Śīl.
junction, connection (in अ-स्˚), Nīlak.
agreement, harmony, MBh.
the body (as having the limbs well compacted), L.
a mail-coat (?), L.
rubbing the limbs, W.
सं-हनन—बलोपेत mfn. endowed with firmness and strength, BhP.
सं-हनन—वत् mfn. strongly built, muscular, robust, Jātakam.
सं-हन˚नोपेत mfn. endowed with strength or muscularity, MBh.
सं-˚हननीय mfn. compact, solid, firm, strong, MBh.
सं-हन्तृ mfn. one who joins or unites, Śaṃk.
सं-हन्˚त्री (˚त्री), f. a female destroyer, Pañcar. (perhaps w.r. for सं-हर्त्री)
सं॑-हान mfn. narrow, MaitrS.
सं॑-हनु mfn. striking the jaws together, AV.
सं॑-हनु ind. (with √ कृ) to seize between the jaws, ib.
सं-हर , ˚रण. See सं-√ हृ.
सं-हर m. drawing together, contracting, MW.
destroying, ib.
N. of an Asura, Hariv.
सं-हार -रक &c. See सं-√ हृ.
सं-हार m. bringing together, collection, accumulation, MBh.
contraction (of the organs of speech, opp. to वि-हार, q.v.), RPrāt.
drawing in (of an elephant's trunk), Ragh.
binding together (of hair; cf. वेणी-स्˚), MBh.
fetching back (an arrow after its discharge by magical means), MBh.; R.; Pur. (cf. IW. 402 n. 1)
abridgment, comprehensive description, a compendium, manual, Lāṭy.
destruction (esp. the periodical des˚ of the universe at end of a Kalpa), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a destroyer (= संहर्तृ), MBh. xiv, 1577
end, conclusion (of a drama or of an act of a drama), Bhar.; Sāh. &c.
a division of the infernal regions, L.
N. of an Asura (v.l. सं-ह्राद), Hariv.
practice, skill, W.
सांहार w.r. for सं-हार.
सं-हर्ष , ˚षण. See सम्-√ हृष्.
सं-हर्ष m. bristling or erection of the hair of the body, thrill of delight, joy, pleasure, MBh.; Śiś.
sexual excitement, Suśr.
ardour, emulation, rivalry, jealousy (cf. सं-घर्ष), MBh.; R. &c.
air, wind, L.
rubbing together, trituration (for संघर्ष), W.
सं-हवन See सं-√ हु.
सं-हवन n. the act of sacrificing together or in a proper manner, MW.
a quadrangle, group of four houses, L.
सं-हाय्यम् ind. being able to rise (in अ-स्˚), PañcavBr.

सं-√ हि P. -हिनोति, to send forth, BhP.;
to bring about, contrive, compose, RV.
सं॑-हित mfn. (√ 1. धा) put together, joined, attached, RV. &c. &c.
fixed, settled, AitBr.
composed of (comp.), ib.
placed together (पार्श्व-स्˚, ‘placed side by side’), Lāṭy.
uninterrupted (as a series of words), RPrāt.
joined or connected or endowed or furnished with, abounding in, possessed of, accompanied by (comp.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
agreeing with, conformable to (धर्म-स्˚, ‘in accordance with justice’), R.
relating to, concerning (comp.), ib.
connected with, proceeding from (comp.), MBh.
being on friendly terms with (instr.), ib.
सं-हित॑ (˚त॑), mfn. mixed in colour, variegated, VS.; TS.
सं॑-हित n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
सं-हित See p. 1123, col. 1.
सं॑-हिता (आ), f., see next
सं-हिता f. conjunction, connection, union, TUp.
(in gram.) the junction or combination of letters according to euphonic rules (= संधि, but sometimes considered rather as the state preparatory to the actual junction than the junction itself), Prāt.

any methodically arranged collection of texts or verses (e.g. the Rāmāyaṇa, the various law-books, the medical works of Caraka and Śārṅgadhara, the complete system of natural astrology &c. [cf. बृहत्-स्˚]; there is also a Saṃhitā of the Purāṇas said to have been compiled by Vyāsa, the substance of which is supposed to be represented by the Viṣṇu-purāṇa), MBh.; VarBṛS.; Pur. &c.
science, L.
the force which holds together and supports the universe (a term applied to the Supreme Being accord. to some), MW.
N. of various works.
सांहित mf(ई)n. relating to the Saṃhitā, found in the S˚ text or based upon it &c., Prāt.; Pāṇ., Sch.
सं-हित—पुष्पिका f. dill (Anethum Panmori), L.
सं॑हितान्त mfn. joined at the ends, AV.
संहितेषु mfn. one who has fitted or placed an arrow on a bow-string, MW.
संहितोरु mfn. having the thighs joined (through obesity), Pāṇ. iv, 1, 70 (cf. संहतोरु).
सं-हिता—कल्प m. N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of the Atharva-veda.
सं-हिता—कार m. the author of a Saṃhitā, Rājat.
सं-हिता—जप m. the recitation of a S˚ (of the Veda), Mn. xi, 201.
सं-हिता—दण्डक m. n. N. of wk.
सं-हिता—दीपक n. N. of wk.
सं-हिता—पाठ m. the continuous text of the Veda (as formed out of the Pada-pāṭha q.v.), Pat., Sch.
सं-हिता—प्रकार m. pl. (with एकादश) N. of a wk. (containing 11 modes of reciting Vedic texts, viz. संहिता, पद, क्रम, जटा, माला, शिखा, लेखा, ध्वज, दण्ड, रथ, गण).
सं-हिता—प्रदीप m. N. of wk.
सं-हिता—भाष्य n. N. of wk.
सं-हिता—रत्नाकर m. N. of wk.
सं-हिता˚ध्ययन (˚ताध्˚), n. the repeating of the S˚ of a Veda, MBh.
सं-हिता˚ध्यायिन् (˚ताध्˚), mfn. repeating the S˚ of a Veda, ib.
सं-हिता˚र्णव (˚तार्न्˚), m. N. of wk.
सं-हिता—वत् ind. as in the Saṃhitā text, MW.
सं-हिता—विधि m. the method of the S˚ text, RPrāt., Sch.
सं-हिता—विधि—विवरण n. N. of wk.
सं-हिता—समान-लक्षण n. N. of a phonetic treatise.
सं-हिता—सार m. N. of astrol. wk.
सं-हिता—सारावली f. N. of astrol. wk.
सं-हिता—सूत्र n. a kind of Prātiśākhya to the Ṛg-veda.
सं-हिता—स्कन्ध m. N. of wk.
सं-हिता—होम-पद्धति f. N. of wk.
संहितोपनिषद् f. N. of an Upaniṣad
संहितोपनिषद्-ब्राह्मण n. of a Brāhmaṇa.
सं॑-हिति f. putting together, connection, MaitrS.
संहितिक w.r. for सांह्˚, APrāt., Sch.
सांहितिक mfn. = सांहित, g. उक्थादि
सांहितिक m. the author of an astrological Saṃhitā, Gaṇit.
संहिती-भाव m. connection, mixture, combination, Car.

सं-√ हु P. -जुहोति, to sacrifice together, VS.;
to sacrifice, MBh.
सं-होत्र॑ n. community of sacrifice,concourse of priests for disputations &c., RV.
सं-होत्र See सं-√ हु, col. 1.
सं-हूति See सम्-√ ह्वे.
सं-हूति f. shouting or calling out together, general shout or clamour, L.
सं-ह˚राख्य m. N. of Agni Pavamāna, MatsyaP.
सं-हरण n. drawing or bringing together, collecting, gathering, MBh.
binding together, arranging (accord. to others ‘cutting’, of hair), Āpast.
taking hold of, seizure, MBh.
fetching back (arrows &c. discharged by magical arts), Uttarar.
destroying, destruction (opp. to ‘creation’), MBh.; Hariv.; Kathās.
सं-हर्तव्य mfn. to be drawn together or collected, Hariv.
to be re-arranged or restored, Sāh.
to be destroyed, Nīlak.
सं-˚हर्तृ mfn. one who draws together or contracts, MW.
one who destroys, a destroyer, MBh.; R. &c.
सं-हार—कारिन् mfn. causing universal destruction, Pañcat.
सं-हार—काल m. the time of the des˚ of the world, MBh.
सं-हार—कालाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते to appear like the time of the des˚ of the w˚, Śukas.
सं-हार—बुद्धि-मत् mfn. intending to destroy the world, Hariv.
सं-हार—भैरव m. Bhairava as world-destroyer (one of the 8 forms of Bh˚ q.v.), Cat.
सं-हार—मुद्रा f. N. of a partic. posture in the Tantra worship (= विसर्जन-मुद्रा), MW.
सं-हार—वर्मन् m. N. of a man, Daś.
सं-हार—वेग-वत् mfn. ardently wishing to destroy the world, MBh.
सं-˚हारक mfn. (cf. अस्थि-स्˚) drawing together, compressing, closing, MW.
destructive, ruinous, ib.
a destroyer, ib.
सं-˚हारिक mfn. all-destroying, Hcat.
सं-˚हारिन् mfn. destroying (ifc.), Kathās.
सं-हार्य mfn. to be brought or drawn together or collected (from various places), ŚāṅkhBr.; ŚrS.
to be transported, transportable, PañcavBr.; ŚrS.
to be avoided, TĀr.
to be removed or checked or restrained (in अ-स्˚), MBh.; R.
to be led astray or corrupted (in अ-स्˚), ib.
to be made to partake of, one who has a claim on (abl.), MBh.
सं-हृत mfn. drawn or brought together &c.
interrupted (in अ-स्˚), Uttarar.
सं-हृत—बुसम् ind. after the chaff has been got in g. तिष्ठद्गु-प्रभृति
सं-हृत—यवम् ind. after the barley has been got in ib.
सं-˚हृति f. the destruction of the universe, MārkP.
conclusion, end, Kathās.; Sāh.
the root हृ with सम्, Śiś.
contraction, abridgment, W.
restraint, ib.
taking, seizure, ib.
सं-˚हृति—मत् mfn. containing the end of (comp.), Sāh.
सं-ह्रियमाण mfn. (Pass. pr. p. of सं-√ हृ) being brought together or in &c.
सं-ह्रियमाण—बुसम् ind. while the chaff is being got in g. तिष्ठद्गु-प्रभृति
सं-ह्रियमाण—यवम् ind. while the barley is being got in ib.
सं-हर्ष—योगिन् mfn. possessing joy, enraptured, W.
सं-˚हर्षण mf(ई)n. causing (the hair of the body) to stand erect (see लोम-ह्˚)
gladdening, delighting (with gen.), MBh.
सं-˚हर्षण n. emulation, rivalry, Kām.
सं-˚हर्षित mfn. (fr. Caus.) bristling, standing erect (as the hair of the body), SaddhP.
सं-˚हर्षिन् mfn. thrilling with joy, gladdening, delighting (comp.), R.
envious, jealous, Śiś.
सं-हृषित mfn. = ˚हर्षित, Jātakam.
stiff or motionless (with fright), Hariv.
सं-हृष्ट mfn. bristling, shuddering, MBh.
one whose hair stands erect (with joy), R.
thrilled, delighted, glad, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
flaming briskly (as fire), R.
सं-हृष्ट—मनस् mfn. delighted in mind, Pañcat.
सं-हृष्ट—रोमन् mfn. one who has the hair of the body bristling (with joy), thrilled, delighted, MBh.
सं-हृष्ट—रोमाङ्ग mfn. one who has the hair of the body bristling (with joy), thrilled, delighted, MBh.
सं-हृष्ट—वत् mfn. joyfully, gladly, R.
सं-हृष्ट—वदन mfn. one whose face is beaming with joy, ib.
सं-˚हृष्टिन् mfn. erect (as the male organ), Car.
सं-ह्राद m. a loud noise, uproar, sound, MBh.; R. &c.
‘Shouter’, N. of an Asura (son of Hiraṇya-kaśipu), MBh.; Hariv.; Pur. (v.l. -ह्लाद).
सं-˚ह्रादन mfn. uttering loud sounds, MBh.
सं-˚ह्रादि m. ‘id.’, N. of a Rākṣasa, R.
सं-˚ह्रादिन् mfn. sounding together, tumultuous, noisy, MBh.
सं-˚ह्रादिन् m. N. of a Rākṣasa, R.
सं-˚ह्रा˚दि-कण्ठ m. n. a noisy voice, Kir.
सं-˚ह्रादीय mfn. relating or belonging to (the Asura) Saṃ-hrāda, Hariv.
सं-ह्रीण mfn. (√ हॄ) altogether ashamed, bashful, modest, Bhaṭṭ.
सं-ह्लाद v.l. (or w.r.) for संह्राद, MBh.
सं-ह्लादिन् mfn. refreshing, cheering, MBh.; Kām.
सं॑-ह्वारित mfn. (fr. Caus. of √ ह्वृ) crooked, curved, bent in (with मध्ये, ‘thinner or more slender in the middle’), ŚBr.
सांहननिक mfn. (fr. सं-हनन) relating to the body, bodily, corporeal, MW.
सांहातिक n. (for सं-हात) N. of the sixteenth Nakṣatra after that in which the moon was situated at a child's birth, L.
सांहितोपनिषद्-भाष्य n. N. of wk.
